A WARNING TO OUR COMMUNITY: PLEASE DO NOT TRUST YOUR FAMILY PETS WITH THIS COMPANY.

The only way I could post this review was by adding a star. My actual rating is -10 stars!

I feel that I have a responsibility to share our experience so other families can make an informed decision before trusting this company with their beloved pets.

We used this mobile grooming company three separate times to groom our German Shepherd. Every single time, he came home extremely anxious, refused to go outside, and was noticeably “off.” At the time, we were concerned, but we never imagined that something far more serious could happen.

On the morning of his most recent grooming appointment, our dog was completely healthy and happy. He had been a part of our family for 12 years. Approximately one hour after his grooming appointment, he suddenly collapsed and died on our bathroom floor.

We’re devastated. We’re angry. And we have so many unanswered questions about what happened to our dog while he was in their care. We’re particularly concerned because of the repeated behavioral changes we witnessed after each grooming appointment and the extremely short time between his final grooming and his death.

We believe he may have been sedated without our permission and may have suffered a seizure and shortly passed on our bathroom floor on his favorite mat, but we’re still trying to determine exactly what happened.

Our dog was not “just a dog.” He was our family. He was our beloved Riley. We loved him for 12 years, and losing him so suddenly has been absolutely heartbreaking for every member of our family.

I’m sharing this because I do not want another family to experience what we went through. Please do your research and think very carefully before placing your family pet in this company’s care.

Our family trusted them with someone we loved dearly. We will forever live with the pain of losing him.

THIS IS FOR RILEY. 🐕🐾

I don’t usually leave reviews, but after trying to reach out to the company directly and getting no response, I feel like I need to share how terrible my experience was.

The groomer told me my dog had fleas, but I knew that wasn’t true. My dog’s on flea medication and had just been to the vet, where they confirmed he didn’t have fleas. Sure, my dog had a few knots in his fur, but the groomer went way overboard and cut way too much off. I was honestly in shock when I saw the result. I trusted the groomer to know what he was doing.

But it gets worse. The groomer actually cut both of my dog’s ears and didn’t say a word about it. He tried to cover the cuts with black powder, but thankfully, my dog’s trainer noticed. Completely unacceptable. To make matters worse, the groomer tried to tell me my dog was a “medium golden doodle” instead of a “mini golden doodle,” and said they would’ve charged more if they had seen a picture of him. Funny thing is, I sent a picture of my dog on Instagram before the appointment. Plus, his birth certificate says he’s a mini golden doodle, and the vet agrees.

The dishonesty and lack of professionalism is just mind-blowing. My dog hasn’t been the same since the haircut, and I can tell something went wrong. I’ll never trust this company with my dog’s grooming again. It’s been such a bad experience, and I honestly regret choosing them.
